title: 11 MCP tools registered, exceeding the required query set
evidence: src/tools.ts:67-330 registers search_matches, team_stats, head_to_head, standings, match_statistics, biggest_wins, last_match, search_players, top_players, brazilian_players_at_brazilian_clubs, list_competitions
suggestion: None — coverage is beyond spec minimum.

title: Robust team-name normalization disambiguates same-base clubs
evidence: src/data/teams.ts:129-154 keeps -UF suffix so Atlético-MG/-GO/Athletico-PR stay distinct; FULL_ALIASES unifies accents across modern/historical files
suggestion: None — directly addresses the spec's 'Team Name Variations' note.

title: Copa do Brasil is split across two competition keys
evidence: src/data/loader.ts:137 emits 'copa-do-brasil' for Brazilian_Cup_Matches.csv while loader.ts:249-251 emits 'copa-do-brasil-ext' for BR-Football-Dataset.csv rows; a search_matches call with competition='copa-do-brasil' misses the extended-file Copa matches
suggestion: Consider merging the two Copa keys or documenting the distinction in the tool description.

title: standings tool has no guard against knockout competitions
evidence: src/tools.ts:158-174 / src/data/query.ts:186 will compute a league table for libertadores/copa-do-brasil scopes, which are knockout formats where a points table is not meaningful
suggestion: Optionally restrict standings to league competitions (brasileirao*/serie-*) or note the caveat; not a spec requirement.

title: Top scorers (optional competition capability) not implemented
evidence: Spec section 4 lists 'Top scorers (if inferable from data)' as optional; the match CSVs carry no scorer/goal-attribution columns, so it is correctly omitted
suggestion: None — explicitly optional and not inferable from the provided data.
